title: Add sell functionality and quantity tracking to semen straw inventory

requirements.summary: Update the add straw form to include a quantity input field that accepts positive integers
acceptanceCriteria: AddStrawForm component includes a quantity input field
Quantity field validates that the value is a positive integer
Form submission includes the quantity value when creating new straws

file_operations.description: Add a quantity input field to the form with validation for positive integers. Update the form state to include quantity and pass it to the addOrUpdateStraw backend function. Ensure the field uses the agricultural-themed styling consistent with existing form inputs.

requirements.summary: Display the quantity column in the inventory table showing the current quantity for each semen straw record
acceptanceCriteria: InventoryTable component displays a quantity column
Quantity values are clearly visible for each straw record
Column is positioned logically within the existing table layout

file_operations.description: Add a Quantity column to the table displaying the quantity value from each SemenStraw record. Position the column between storage location and status columns. Format the quantity as a readable number.

requirements.summary: Add the ability to edit quantity in the EditStrawForm component
acceptanceCriteria: EditStrawForm includes a quantity input field pre-filled with current value
Users can update the quantity when editing a straw record
Quantity field validates positive integers on edit

file_operations.description: Add a quantity input field to the edit form, pre-filled with the current straw's quantity value. Include validation for positive integers and pass the updated quantity to the addOrUpdateStraw backend function on form submission.

requirements.summary: Add a sell/sale functionality to record semen straw sales with fields for sale date, buyer information, quantity sold, and sale price
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend includes a form or dialog to record a sale for a specific straw
Recording a sale reduces the quantity of the associated straw record
Sales history is accessible from the frontend

file_operations.description: Create a dialog component for recording sales with input fields for sale date, buyer name, buyer contact, quantity sold, and sale price. Include validation to ensure quantity sold does not exceed available quantity. Use the createSale backend function to record the sale. Display success/error notifications using toast.

Add React Query hooks for sale operations: useCreateSale mutation to call the createSale backend function, useAllSales query to fetch all sales using getAllSales, and useSaleById query to fetch individual sale records. Ensure the createSale mutation invalidates both straws and sales query caches.

Create a page component displaying all recorded sales in a table format with columns for sale ID, straw ID, sale date, buyer name, buyer contact, quantity sold, and sale price. Include loading states and error handling using the useAllSales hook.
Add a route for the SalesHistory page in the TanStack Router configuration. Update navigation in the Layout component to include a link to the sales history page.
Add a navigation link to the Sales History page in the header, positioned alongside the dashboard link. Maintain the agricultural-themed styling for the navigation.

requirements.summary: Display a sell/sale action button in the inventory table for each straw record to initiate the sale recording process
acceptanceCriteria: Each row in the inventory table includes a sell button or action
Clicking the sell button opens a sale recording form/dialog
The sell option is clearly visible and accessible

file_operations.description: Add a Sell action button to each row in the Actions column. Clicking the button opens the SaleDialog component with the selected straw's ID and quantity pre-filled. Disable the sell button when quantity is zero or status is not Available. Integrate the SaleDialog component into the table.
